from qiskit import QuantumCircuit


def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    # rotate right by one: x0..x_{n-1} -> x_{n-1} x0..x_{n-2}
    # bubble the last qubit to the front with adjacent swaps
    # swap i, i-1 can be done with 3 CNOTs
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        # swap qubits i and i-1
        qc.cx(i, i - 1)
        qc.cx(i - 1, i)
        qc.cx(i, i - 1)
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit.library import Permutation


def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    # right rotation: output[i] <- input[(i-1) mod n]
    perm = [(i - 1) % n for i in range(n)]
    qc.append(Permutation(perm), range(n))
    return qc

import numpy as np


def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    size = 1 << n
    mat = np.zeros((size, size), dtype=np.complex128)

    # right rotation:  y_k = x_{(k-1) mod n}
    for i in range(size):
        j = 0
        for k in range(n):
            bit = (i >> ((k - 1) % n)) & 1
            j |= bit << k
        mat[j, i] = 1.0

    qc.append(UnitaryGate(mat), range(n))
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit


def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    # left rotation of Qiskit wires = right rotation of the mathematical string
    # q_k -> q_{k+1}  (mod n)
    # bubble qubit 0 to the end with adjacent swaps
    for i in range(n - 1):
        # swap i and i+1 with 3 CNOTs
        qc.cx(i, i + 1)
        qc.cx(i + 1, i)
        qc.cx(i, i + 1)
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit


def solve(n: int) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)
    # right cyclic shift  x0..x_{n-1} -> x_{n-1} x0..x_{n-2}
    # bubble the last qubit to the front with adjacent swaps
    # a swap of wires a,b can be done with three CNOTs
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        a = i - 1
        b = i
        qc.cx(a, b)
        qc.cx(b, a)
        qc.cx(a, b)
    return qc
